styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep midnight navy #0E1730 hero panels with a fine dotted halftone glow, alternating with steel blue-grey #5C7089 info panels and thin neon-violet wave lines
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool studio lighting, soft top key plus a cool rim light outlining the circular airflow ring, controlled metallic speculars, soft contact shadows, no harsh hot spots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte charcoal panel #14161C and brushed dark metal with faint reflection, champagne-copper #C08A5A reserved for small metallic detail accents
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif throughout; heavy uppercase English eyebrow line plus short Chinese headlines in #D8E1EC wrapped in 「」, headlines 28-48pt and labels 10-14pt

styleLock.presentationRules: keep the hollow circular airflow ring visible and facing camera or at 3/4; stable product scale and placement across the set; deep navy background first; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark tech hairdryer visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep midnight navy #0E1730, steel blue-grey #5C7089, mist blue #D8E1EC, one magenta accent #C22A7E and one champagne-copper metallic detail #C08A5A reserved for small detail accents; cool tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with short Chinese copy wrapped in 「」, no serif and no handwritten type; background system of deep midnight navy #0E1730 hero panels with a fine dotted halftone glow alternating with steel blue-grey #5C7089 info panels and thin neon-violet wave lines; cool studio lighting with a soft top key and a cool rim light outlining the circular airflow ring, controlled metallic speculars and soft contact shadows; matte charcoal #14161C panel and brushed dark metal surfaces; rounded rectangular info labels, chrome-gradient circular icon badges and numbered step markers; thin-line rounded icons in #D8E1EC; the hollow circular airflow ring stays visible and the product scale stays stable; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no bright white studio background, no warm color cast.
